tags.name: Le Roraima (épave)
tags.notes: Re-audited 2026-08-13: cross-checked English Wikipedia, French Wikipedia, tribloo.com, archeonavale.org and quebecyachting.ca. CORRECTED: launched as Ghazee (Mogul Steamship Co, Glasgow) in 1883, purchased by Quebec Steamship Company 30 Nov 1899 (not 1900) and renamed Roraima. Length/depth figures conflict across sources - see markdown for stated ranges. Cousteau's 'white-haired wreck' nickname confirmed by 2+ French-language sources, referring to white sea-pens (virgulaires) rather than algae per the more specific French sources.

tags.name: Épave Amelie
tags.notes: Re-audited 2026-08-13: DEPTH CORRECTED from 6m to 12m - Wikipedia, espaceplongee-martinique.com ('10m') and quebecyachting.ca ('12m') converge on 9-12m rather than the previously listed 6m. tags.name: Grand-Caye
tags.notes: Re-audited 2026-08-13: this is the real, well-documented 'La Grande Caye' site east of Sainte-Luce - a ~200m coral reef with roughly 50 coral species, one of the richest in the Lesser Antilles per paradisplongee.com. Martinique Biodiversity Observatory (biodiversite-martinique.fr) documented coral spawning here in 2019. Accessible only by guided boat excursion.
